bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for the Minnesota Age in Place Network.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; AGE WELL AT HOME.

$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to Age Well at Home, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to establish the Minnesota Age in Place Network. Eligible uses of grant money are providing home modifications and safety renovations at the owner-occupied homes of older low- to moderate-income homeowners. No single modification or renovation project may exceed $20,000. Age Well at Home may also use up to ten percent of the grant money for administrative expenses attributable to establishing, expanding, and maintaining the Minnesota Age in Place Network. This is a onetime appropriation.
